text_block_list.text:
The pranks from Shinko Windy continued
unabated, 
but I eventually understood something.
And that was―

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: Shinko Windy falls back in to 2nd place……!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wahahahahahaha! You fell for it,
you fell for it～!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy challenged for the lead,
but fell one step short……!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gyahahahahaha!! I surprised you,
I surprised you! 
Hey hey! Come and get me～!

On the days she lost races,
she would definitely come 
and play pranks on me.
After seeing me be surprised, a big 
smile would be on her face.

Shinko Windy would vent her frustration 
from losing by playing pranks on people.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Waa haa haa haa haa! Once again,
today you'll 
fall prey to Windy-chan's twisted
machinations!

It'd be nice if after relieving her
stress 
through pranks she'd get to training――

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ! Ehehee!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Windy-chan won't be stopped by anyone!

After I had realized that, 
I did my best to react in an appropriate
way.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ni shi shi shi! It went well yesterday,
it went well! 
That person is really interesting!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And whenever they look at Windy-chan,
their eyes go wide……! 
Ukukukukuu! What should I do next time～!?

And so the days continued on like that……
until one day. 
I had to take leave from the school for
additional training.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Kufuu, kufufufufuu! 
I've got a special prank for you today.
It'll shock you for sure.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's this? A note?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
………… 
『Away for additional training――』……

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ……Hmmmm～

The training was stricter and took more time
than I thought. 
Before I knew it,
several weeks had passed――

Finally,
I was eventually able to return to school.
On that day―

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
No way, no way, no way! 
If I say I'm not entering,
then I'm not entering!

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
But, if you keep skipping Selection
Races, 
eventually it'll eventually lead to you
dropping out――

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Shut up! 
I'm done with this, all of it,
I'm quitting～!

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Ah! 
Wait, Shinko Windy!

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
……Well, these past few weeks her boycotts 
and pranks have gotten more extreme.

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
It's the same with her classes,
but she won't enter Selection 
Races. And I just now asked her why,
but it seems she can't 
properly put it in to words.

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
……and more than anything, her pranks…… 
take a look at that wall.

I looked to where she pointed…… A large
self-portrait was 
spray-painted on the wall of the school.

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
This is also partly our fault.
The level of her pranks 
was starting to get out of hand,
so we wanted to stop her 
before something big happened.

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Since our reactions seemed to make her
overjoyed, 
we did our best to try and respond by
remaining calm――

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
But, that just seemed to make things
worse……!

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
……Haa…… At the very least,
if things could calm down 
and we could talk it out,
it would be nice……

Before I went away for training, 
the pranks weren't anything more than just
minor mischief.

Unable to just stand idly by,
I chased after Shinko Windy. 
She was…… standing in a corner behind the
school building.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
………… 
……Hmph. This is fine.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ……races, and pranks too…… they aren't fun.

I might have misunderstood.
I had thought it was just 
restlessness caused by being unable to win,
but――

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: After all, nobody's even watching me……

『I want to watch Windy-chan more』, 
that was the thought that was in the back
of my mind.
